title: Concept: Politically exposed person status exposed
description: A PEP status field on a customer or beneficiary record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: PEP status is derived from screening data about public office, so exposing it tells the subject they are flagged and gives an attacker a profile of which relationships the bank scrutinises.
applicability: Deployments that render a PEP status field on a customer or beneficiary record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: PEP status is derived from screening data about public office, so exposing it tells the subject they are flagged and gives an attacker a profile of which relationships the bank scrutinises.
